title: Brazil's Forest Production Hits R$ 47.9 Billion in 2025
subtitle: Economic Value of Forest Production Grows 6.7% Year-over-Year
excerpt: Brazil's forests generated R$ 47.9 billion in economic output in 2025, marking a 6.7% increase from 2024.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazilian forests generated an economic output valued at R$ 47.9 billion in 2025. This marks the highest value ever achieved in Brazil, representing a 6.7% increase compared to the previous year.

The 6.7% increase underscores the expansion of forestry activity nationwide, reflecting the sector's crucial importance for revenue generation and job creation.

With this strong performance, forest production solidifies its position as a pillar of the Brazilian economy, contributing significantly to overall economic growth.

With information from Agência Brasil.
